title: You Can Stop Rewriting Them
core_idea: Acceptance of another person means seeing them as they are instead of waiting for who they might become, and then choosing freely how close to be.
text: Have you ever spent years waiting for someone to become a different person? A parent who finally says the right words. A friend who finally changes. Hoping is human. But quietly, that waiting can keep us tied to a version of them that may never arrive. Acceptance doesn't mean you approve of everything, or that you stay close to what hurts. It means you stop rewriting them in your mind. You see them as they are, and then you decide, from that clear place, how near you want to be. There is often a strange relief in that. You can finally put the pen down.
description: A gentle reflection on accepting people as they are, and choosing from that clear place how close you want to be.
